title: Testing - Automation-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role Summary**
**Job Description – QA Automation Engineer**
 We are seeking a dedicated QA Automation Engineer responsible for ensuring software quality through automated testing, integration testing, regression testing, and release validation. while also supporting manual testing activities as needed to ensure comprehensive test coverage and high\-quality software releases.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using modern automation frameworks.
* Create and execute SIT, Regression Testing, and End\-to\-End Testing.
* Develop reusable automation components and test frameworks.
* Validate application functionality, integrations, APIs, and data flows.
* Support release cycles through comprehensive test planning and execution.
* Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and test data.
* Identify, document, and track software defects through resolution.
* Collaborate with development, business, and product teams to ensure quality objectives are met.
* Perform exploratory and manual testing when automation is not applicable.
* Participate in requirement reviews and provide testability feedback.
* Analyse test results and provide quality metrics and reports.


**Technical Skills \& Tools (Required)**
* Playwright, C\# /.NET, JavaScript / TypeScript, REST API Testing \& Postman, SQL and Database Validation, Git Version Control, Azure DevOps


**Engineering Practices**
* Test Strategy and Planning, System Integration Testing (SIT), Regression Testing, Defect Lifecycle Management, Release Validation, Agile/Scrum Methodologies, Continuous Quality Improvement


**Experience**
* 5\- 10 years of experience in Software Testing and Test Automation.
* Strong hands\-on experience building and maintaining automation frameworks.
* Experience with API, Integration, Regression, and End\-to\-End Testing.
* Experience testing modern web applications, preferably React\-based applications.
* Experience supporting Agile delivery and frequent release cycles.


**Nice to Have**
* Exposure to Performance Testing, React.js, Python \& Django, Security Testing, Accessibility Testing, Test Management Tools, Experience testing enterprise\-scale applications


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
* A highly motivated QA Automation Engineer with strong automation expertise and a quality\-first mindset. The candidate should be capable of independently driving automation strategy, framework development, API and integration testing, regression testing, and release validation, while also contributing to manual and exploratory testing activities when required. The ideal candidate will collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software releases.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - Mainframe Modernization- GEN AI - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AIA – Mainframe Modernization Specialist**
**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a skilled
 **Senior Mainframe Modernization Specialist** 
 to join our
 **AI\-Driven Modernization** 
 practice, focused on transforming
 **legacy mainframe systems** 
 into agile, efficient, and cloud\-ready platforms. The ideal candidate will bring a strong blend of
 **mainframe expertise, AI tools proficiency, and cloud technologies** 
 along with
 **hands\-on collaboration** 
 with cross\-functional teams to deliver scalable modernization outcomes.
   

  

 You will work closely with technology leads, architects, and business stakeholders to analyse legacy applications, leverage AI/ML to automate code analysis and refactoring, and execute migration of mainframe workloads to modern distributed and cloud\-native platforms.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence:**
* Mainframe Systems Analysis and Understanding


* 
+ Assess and analyse existing mainframe applications (COBOL, JCL, VSAM, DB2, CICS, IMS) to identify modernization opportunities and dependencies.
+ Document current\-state architecture, data flows, batch schedules, and integration points across legacy ecosystem components.
+ Perform impact analysis and complexity assessment for potential transitions to modern platforms.
+ AI\-Driven Mainframe Modernization


* 
+ Apply AI tools and custom AI agentic workflows for automated code analysis, refactoring, and technical debt reduction.
+ Develop and fine\-tune AI\-powered assistants to accelerate system conversion and code translation (e.g., COBOL to Java/Python).
+ Apply prompt engineering and context engineering techniques to maximise accuracy and efficiency of LLM\-driven modernization workflows.
+ Modernization Execution


* 
+ Execute modernization tasks including rehosting, refactoring, or rebuilding mainframe workloads based on defined strategies.
+ Participate in the design and implementation of target\-state architectures aligned with cloud\-native and microservices patterns.
+ Ensure code quality, testability, and maintainability throughout the modernization lifecycle.
+ API and Microservices Development


* 
+ Contribute to the design and development of API integrations and microservices to replace or wrap legacy mainframe functionality.
+ Implement RESTful APIs, event\-driven architectures, and integration patterns as part of the target\-state solution.
+ Cloud and Platform Integration


* 
+ Support migration of mainframe workloads to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) using AI\-driven solutions.
+ Integrate modernized components with cloud\-native services, containerised workloads (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
+ Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code, observability, and security best practices for modernized workloads.
+ Documentation and Reporting


* 
+ Create and maintain technical documentation including system designs, migration runbooks, and AI pipeline configurations.
+ Provide regular status updates on modernization progress, risks, and deliverables to project leads.


**Skills and Attributes:**
**Educational Background**
* B.Tech / B.E. / MCA / M.Tech or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.


**Professional Experience**
* 5 to 9 years of hands\-on experience with legacy mainframe systems (COBOL, JCL, Assembler, CICS, DB2, IMS, VSAM).
* Experience with data migration, integration, ETL processes, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Proficiency in programming/scripting languages such as Python and/or Java.
* Working knowledge of APIs, microservices architecture, and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Hands\-on experience with AI tools, LLM API calls, prompt engineering, and context engineering for automating code analysis and modernization workflows.
* Experience with mainframe modernization tools or platforms (e.g., Micro Focus, AWS Mainframe Modernization, Azure Migrate) is a plus.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear documentation and presentations.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP), AI/ML certifications, or mainframe\-related certifications are a plus.


**Why Join Us**
* Be at the forefront of AI\-driven mainframe modernization across enterprise clients.
* Work with global teams to drive real business impact through digital transformation.
* Collaborate with a team of modernization experts, AI specialists, and technology leaders in a highly innovative environment.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, serving our clients locally and globally with innovation and at scale.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Team Lead – Software Engineering
description:
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Team Lead to build and lead a team of software engineers developing a strategically important cloud\-based platform that enables customers to check and improve the accuracy of their X\-Rite color measurement devices.
   

  

 This is a player\-coach role, combining hands\-on software development with technical leadership and people management. The role focuses on enabling team effectiveness, technical excellence, cloud\-native architecture, and continuous improvement in a global engineering environment.
   

  

 The team owns a modern web application built with TypeScript, React, Redux, HTML, CSS, AWS, Lambda, Node.js, and serverless technologies, as well as a companion Qt/C\+\+ desktop application responsible for collecting and managing data that is integrated into the cloud platform.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing team of software engineers
* Hire, onboard, motivate, and coach team members, fostering engagement, growth, and a strong team culture
* Contribute hands\-on to software development, including design, implementation, code reviews, and technical problem solving — leveraging AI throughout the software development lifecycle
* Provide technical leadership and guide architectural decisions for both the cloud platform and associated desktop applications in collaboration with global engineering teams (US, Switzerland, India, Germany, Netherlands, North Macedonia)
* Own and evolve scalable, secure, and maintainable cloud\-native architectures on AWS
* Drive the evolution of frontend and backend systems, ensuring high performance, reliability, usability, and security
* Collaborate closely with product management, UX, QA, data engineering, and application support teams to deliver customer value
* Facilitate Agile ways of working (Scrum/Kanban), supporting effective planning, execution, prioritization, and delivery
* Establish and continuously improve software engineering practices, including testing, CI/CD, cloud operations, observability, security, and effective usage of AI
* Ensure seamless integration between cloud services and desktop applications that contribute data to the platform
* Work closely with global stakeholders across India, Europe, and the US to align technical direction with product strategy
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and engineering excellence


**Required Qualifications \& Professional Knowledge**
* 8\+ years of relevant experience in software engineering
* 3\+ years of experience leading software engineering teams
* Strong hands\-on experience building and maintaining modern web applications
* Several years of experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Redux, HTML, and CSS
* Strong backend development experience with Node.js and TypeScript
* Experience designing and operating cloud\-native solutions on AWS or Azure
* Solid understanding of serverless architectures and services such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and related cloud technologies
* Experience designing scalable distributed systems and defining application architectures
* Ability to analyze customer and business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions
* Experience establishing engineering best practices including testing strategies, CI/CD, code quality, monitoring, and security
* Solid understanding of modern web application architecture and software design principles
* Experience collaborating with UX, Product Management, QA, and other engineering disciplines
* Ability to collaborate effectively with global, cross\-functional teams
* Solid understanding of the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle
* Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum and/or Kanban)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Willingness to travel (10%)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience leading teams developing cloud\-native SaaS or enterprise software platforms
* Experience with AWS services beyond Lambda and API Gateway, such as RDS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch
* Experience with DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud automation
* Experience working with data\-intensive applications, analytics platforms, or data pipelines
* Experience working in geographically distributed teams


**Nice to Have**
* Knowledge of desktop software development using C\+\+ and Qt
* Experience integrating desktop, edge, or device\-connected applications with cloud services
* Knowledge of color management, measurement systems, or hardware\-connected software solutions


**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* :5\+ years of experience delivering and evolving commercial software products throughout their lifecycle
* Experience balancing technical leadership, people leadership, and hands\-on software development responsibilities


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to balance hands\-on work with leadership responsibilities
* Passion for building high\-performing engineering teams and developing people
* Collaborative and pragmatic approach in a cross\-functional, global environment
* High learning agility and enthusiasm for modern software engineering practices, cloud technologies, and AI\-assisted development
* Ability to make sound technical and organizational decisions in a fast\-paced environment
* Effective communicator capable of aligning stakeholders across multiple functions and regions


 Ability to operate effectively in a distributed team with partial timezone overlap (India ↔ US/EU)
   

  

 We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team.
   

  

**We Offer**
* A dynamic, international, and innovative work environment.
* Exciting technical challenges and expert colleagues with decades of experience in the field.
* A position in our Bangalore office with flexibility in the time schedule and hybrid work model.
* A human\-sized organization where you'll have contact beyond the R\&D department.
* Coaching and learning opportunities at every stage of your career.
* The opportunity to work on business\-critical data platforms that support decision\-making across the company.
* Be part of building products that address real\-world challenges for customers across global industries. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership, influence technical decisions, and see your contributions create measurable business value.
* Direct collaboration with engineers, product managers, support teams, and business stakeholders across Europe, Asia, and North America.
* A culture that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and constructive challenges.
* The freedom to contribute ideas, drive improvements, and influence technical direction.
* Team leads are trusted to contribute not only technical expertise, but also vision, coaching, and leadership that help shape the future of our products and organization.


 Immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic workplace that spans industries such as printing, packaging, photography, graphic design, video, automotive, paints, plastics, and textiles. Join a team that thrives on pushing the boundaries of what's possible, where innovation meets impact, and cross\-functional teamwork sets us apart.
   

  

 At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

title: Tech S And T Product Engineer-Ardoq-NGTO-Senior-GDSF02
description:
